name: EmptyState
intent: What a list, page or panel shows when it has nothing yet: an icon, a title, a line of help and the action that fills it.
usage: Use EmptyState in place of content that isn't there yet: a list with no rows, a new account's first screen, a panel with nothing selected. It is one component: pass title, and add description, icon and actions as needed. icon shows in a round well above the title, or large and filled with iconStyle="plain"; media replaces it with a kit Avatar or AvatarGroup. actions holds kit Buttons, like one primary Create and a secondary Import. outlined adds a border and a card fill, for an empty region inside a page. See contracts/emptystate.json for the full contract.

title.note: What is empty, like No invoices yet. A heading: h3 unless headingLevel says otherwise.

description.note: One or two lines on why and what to do next.

icon.note: Material Symbols name, shown above the title: in a round well, or large with iconStyle plain.

iconStyle.note: well puts the icon in a small grey circle. plain shows it large and filled with no circle, like the search icon on a too-many-results list.

media.note: In place of the icon: a kit Avatar or AvatarGroup, like the person who is away.

actions.note: Kit Buttons in a row under the text. One primary per view.

outlined.note: A border and a card fill around it.

headingLevel.note: Which heading the title is. 2 when the empty state sits right under the page title (a ListPage with no records); 3 inside a Section.

useWhen: A list or table with no rows yet, or no results for a filter.
A new account's first screen, or a panel with nothing selected.
doNot: Do not invent EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription or EmptyContent. Pass props.
Do not use it for page messages like errors or warnings. Use Callout.
Do not use it while content is loading.
a11y: The title is a heading, h3 by default; set headingLevel so it follows the headings around it (h2 right under the page title, h3 inside a Section). The description is a paragraph under it.
Actions are ordinary kit Buttons in reading order.
snippet:
<EmptyState
  icon="receipt_long"
  title="No invoices yet"
  description="Create an invoice or import them from a file."
  actions={<>
    <Button variant="primary">Create invoice</Button>
    <Button>Import</Button>
  </>}
/>
